title: As described. Quiet compared to other ones. Easy to fill.
text: As described. Quiet compared to other ones. Easy to fill.. This humidifier works well so far. Considering some of the reviews, pretty quiet operation. Reservoir does last for a long time if ran at lower output setting (logical). Not obvious in the room compared to decor. No light in the lower priced model. Auto shutoff worked fine. As described. Hope it lasts for a while.

product_metadata.title: BEAR Humidifiers for Bedroom, 3L Cool Mist Humidifiers and Oil Diffuser, Quiet Rapid humidifiers for Home Whole House, with Adjustable Mist Output and Auto Shut-off, White
features: 3L COOL MIST HUMIDIFIERS: With a 3-liter (0.8 gallon) tank, this humidifier provides 25 hours of moisture for comfortable sleep without congestion, dry skin, coughing, or dry mouth.
HUMIDIFIER & DIFFUSER 2 IN 1: Fill your room with your favorite essential oils, while enjoying the humidifier’s cool mist.
ADJUSTABLE MIST OUT: Use the knob to control mist output and the 360° nozzle to direct mist anywhere you like.
PERFECT FOR BEDROOM: Your baby will sleep soundly and safely every night thanks to the auto-shut off feature and nearly silent operation.
GUARANTEED PURCHASE:With 2-year warranty and life-long service, you can contact our support team for a replacement whenever finding the product damaged or used.
